bds.h: Student pilot safely lands after surprise nationwide FAA ground stop during first solo flight
bds.lede: As Friday’s nationwide FAA ground stop went into effect, North Texas student pilot Mosab Nadi was already in the air on his first solo cross-country flight.
rows: President Trump was informed within 30 minutes after the Federal Aviation Administration imposed a nationwide ground stop Friday afternoon, according to U.S. officials.
As Friday’s nationwide FAA ground stop went into effect, North Texas student pilot Mosab Nadi was already in the air on his first solo cross-country flight.
Friday's ground stop resulted in thousands of cancelled flights.
President Trump blamed the Federal Aviation Administration's nationwide ground stop on "old equipment" and stood by Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy's response to the incident.
Although the United States nationwide flight ground stop was resolved within a few hours Friday night – some Canadian passengers are still dealing with the repercussions.
There was a weekend of disruption as the national air-traffic control system recovered from a technical failure.
